name: fixpoint
description: USD-priced escrow on Hedera: invoices in dollars, payment in HBAR at a live Pyth rate, HTS NFT receipts, HCS audit trail.

steps.label: Copy the env files
steps.text: Run cp .env.example packages/nextjs/.env and cp .env.example packages/hardhat/.env, then set DATABASE_URL in the frontend env to your Postgres URL and run npm run db:push and npm run db:seed
For Hedera testnet deploy and verify, see docs/testnet-evidence.md and packages/hardhat/README.md.

envVars.description: WalletConnect cloud project id for HashPack pairing (demo mode works without it)
Live contract for wallet reads and writes, defaults to the testnet deployment
HTS receipt token for wallet pay with mint, empty until the collection exists
HCS audit topic shown in wallet flows
Postgres connection string for the demo ledger, direct URL for db push, pooled URL at runtime
Optional Pyth Hermes API key, sent as x-api-key. Without it the app shows a labelled offline seed price
Testnet operator account for deploy and relayer scripts (ECDSA account, never commit)
Testnet operator private key for deploy and relayer scripts (never commit)
Pyth receiver contract address (defaults to the Hedera testnet receiver)
Pyth HBAR/USD feed id (resolve via Hermes price_feeds?query=HBAR)
Override for the HCS audit topic id
Override for the HTS receipt token id
Override for the mirror node REST base URL
